evidence.observation: Tube pressure has risen monotonically through growth from ~2.90 to 3.175 Torr while Ar setpoint/flow held at 100 sccm and T at 750 °C
MFC flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by a flow change
Thermocouple tracks setpoint within ~1 °C with plausible heater power, so temperature control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 (or RGA/leak-check) reading to distinguish an air in-leak from a downstream exhaust restriction; alternatively a brief Ar flow step or pump-valve test to see whether pressure responds as expected.
